segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Hello, this is Sam Rivera from Northbeam sales. Before we start, this call is being recorded for note taking.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi Sam, thanks for making time. We are a logistics company with about forty people in the office and we need a better way to track shipments.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Great, tell me what you use today.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Mostly spreadsheets and a shared inbox. It breaks every week when two people edit the same file.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Understood. For forty seats our Team plan fits, and it includes single sign on. I'll send you a quote for forty seats by Friday.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Good. Single sign on is a must for us, our IT lead asked about it twice. Can you also share the security overview?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Yes, I will share the security overview after this call. Let me schedule a demo with your IT lead next week.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Perfect, that sounds good. Please book it for Tuesday morning.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Done, I'll book a demo for Tuesday and send the invite today. Anything else?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: No, thank you, this was very helpful.
